$comment: maxJavaScriptGzipBytes counts EVERY .js file in the web export, on-demand chunks included. Raised 2410000 -> 2710000 with Bloom 6 (Allo#185): measured 2161297 on main and 2607534 after, of which 402 KB gzip is Bloom's per-language message catalogues, each its own chunk loaded only for a person using that language; the rest is Bloom 6 (+~12 KB) and dotLottie, the web sticker renderer (+~33 KB). Raised 2710000 -> 2740000 with Bloom 7.31 (inline video on iPhone Safari): measured 2707482 on main and 2726314 after (+18.8 KB gzip). A source-map attribution of the entry chunk puts all of it in Bloom (+59.7 KB raw: web forks and motion/scroll-metrics helpers the families Allo already uses gained across 7.2-7.31, e.g. AppShellSplitMotion, Accordion.web, Radio/RatingBar/Meter web forks) and +1.2 KB in react-native-css 3.1.0-rc.0; services 11.1.17 adds nothing. Raised 2740000 -> 2950000 with Ask Alia (Bloom 7.31 -> 10.4, services 11.2, @alia.onl/sdk 13.1 with AliaChatSheet): measured 2928161 on the feature commit, 2928254 with the native portal mount (+93 B); the growth is the upgrades and the chat sheet, not the barrel. Allo imports Bloom by subpath only, so this is not a barrel regression. Raised 2950000 -> 3150000 for real encrypted group video: measured 3118924 bytes total gzip, including the lazy groupMedia/LiveKit chunk (149743 B) and same-origin encryption worker (29930 B). The rest of this export is 2939251 B, within the previous limit. Both new media assets load only for a group call; the gate still counts them. Physical native interoperability is separately pending. Raised 3150000 -> 3270000 with Expo SDK 58 (React Native 0.88): measured 3139027 on main and 3264943 after (+125916 B gzip), every byte of it in on-demand chunks: the JavaScript the first page loads went DOWN from 2116465 to 1989130 B gzip, because Ask Alia now comes from @alia.onl/sdk/ask and its sheet is a 249.7 KB gzip chunk fetched for the first ask. A source-map attribution over all chunks: @alia.onl/sdk 15.6 -> 21.5, its first React Native 0.88 line, +58.7 KB, and the Bloom 14 components its chat uses +54.0 KB (same Bloom version on both sides); react-native-gesture-handler 3 +15.7 KB while @egjs/hammerjs leaves (-7.9 KB); react-dom 19.3 +8.8 KB; react-native-reanimated 4.7 -10.2 KB. The app's own modules read +24.1 KB, mostly locale JSON that SDK 57's source maps left unattributed. Raised 3270000 -> 3280000 with services 12.4.0 / core 6.1.0 / contracts 5.1.0: measured 3261647 on main and 3270389 after (+8742 B gzip, Bun's gzip as `bun run check:web-bundle-budget` uses), almost all on demand: services' new Sign-in & security screens +2162 B in the screenComponents chunk and core's signInSecurity strings +~5.9 KB across the 24 per-language chunks; the entry chunk grew +652 B and the JavaScript the first page loads +676 B (1987823 -> 1988499, gzip -9). Raised 3280000 -> 3290000 with core 6.5.0 / contracts 5.3.0 (the backend's oxyTrustProxy; the server code is not in the export, no Cloudflare range reaches any chunk): measured 3270391 on main and 3276525 after locally (+6134 B), 3276194 and 3281911 in CI (+5717 B; CI's export runs ~5.8 KB above a local one on both sides). Of the local +6134 B, +4933 B is core 6.3-6.4's follow.* and account-kind strings across the ten per-language chunks loaded only for that language (+452 to +570 B each), and +1237 B is the entry chunk, which carries the same strings in English and contracts 5.3's account title policy; every other chunk moved by under 30 B. Raised 3290000 -> 3300000 with services 12.12.0 / core 6.14.0: measured 3287638 on main and 3287956 after locally (+318 B gzip); CI measured 3292999 on this change, so main was already within ~2.7 KB of the old limit once CI's ~5.8 KB higher export is counted. The services bump itself is negligible. Raised 3300000 -> 3360000 with Bloom 15.48 / services 13.3 / core 7.2 / contracts 6 / @alia.onl/sdk 21.5.4: measured 3292594 on main and 3342139 after locally (+49545 B). All of it is on demand: core 6.15 added five languages, each its own catalogue chunk loaded only for that language (bn-BD, hi-IN, id-ID, ru-RU, tr-TR: +47395 B), and the existing per-language chunks grew +0.7-0.9 KB each. The entry chunk went DOWN 27516 B: two Bloom icon barrel imports (Allo's composer staging and @alia.onl/sdk <= 21.5.3, fixed in OxyHQ/Alia#891) carried the whole Remix set (~95 KB gzip), and Bloom 15.1-15.48's app shell, sidebar, theme and screen growth (+~65 KB gzip in the entry) now fits inside what they freed. `check:bundle-imports` refuses a value import from Bloom's root or icon barrel from now on. Re-measured on the same limit after rebasing onto #254 and #257 (expo-crypto, the start-failure screen) with services 13.4.0 / app-preset 5.0.0: 3337936 locally before #257 and 3338818 after it (+882 B, the start-failure screen), below the 3342139 measured with services 13.3. Raised 3360000 -> 3440000 with Bloom 16.0.2 / services 14.0.0 / core 7.11.0: CI measured 3418969 on this change (3360000 was already the limit on main); the growth is on-demand chunks and per-language catalogues from the upgrades, no Allo code changed. Raised 3440000 -> 3500000 with core 7.48.0 / services 14.19.0 / contracts 6.24.0 / Bloom 17.21.0: measured 3455848 locally on this change (+15.8 KB over the old limit; CI runs ~5.8 KB above a local export). Bloom 17.23+ is NOT adoptable under any sane budget: it embeds the agent-avatar vector catalogue (58 MB raw, 112 chunks), taking the export to 76.7 MB / 15.9 MB gzip, so Bloom stays at 17.21.0 until that is fixed upstream. Raised 3500000 -> 3705000 with @gemies/sdk 3.0.0, which replaces @alia.onl/sdk and needs Bloom >=20 (Bloom 17.21.0 -> 20.0.0). Bloom's agent-avatar catalogue is 636 on-demand chunks, one packed vector payload each, fetched only when an avatar is drawn and never by the first page (the gate fails if one is), so it has its own line (maxAvatarCatalogBytes / maxAvatarCatalogGzipBytes: measured 30484489 B, 7062151 B gzip) and the other limits measure everything else. Everything else measured 3450461 on main and 3688726 after locally (+238265 B gzip); total 18484276 B. A per-module source-map attribution over every non-catalogue chunk puts all of it in Bloom 17.21 -> 20 (+244780 B, summed per-module gzip; +122308 B of it in the three scripts the first page loads); @gemies/sdk is 160935 B where @alia.onl/sdk 22.10 was 161477 B. Raised 3705000 -> 3980000 with Bloom 21.0.0 / contracts 7.0.0 / core 7.49.0 / services 14.21.0 / @gemies/sdk 3.1.0: measured 3688731 on main and 3958552 after locally (+269821 B gzip). All of it is the on-demand GemieAskSheetWithVoice chunk, fetched with the first ask and never by the first page (entry +2.3 KB raw): a per-module source-map attribution of that chunk puts +346431 B raw in Bloom 21's agent-creator/rainbow-artwork.js, the custom colour swatch's light and dark PNG artwork embedded as base64 data URIs (262070 B gzip on its own), and +16.4 KB raw in the restored CustomColorPicker and GlossArt. The weight is Bloom's to shed (an asset or a lazily loaded module instead of inline base64); this limit comes back down when it does. Lowered 3980000 -> 3710000 with Bloom 21.1.1 (OxyHQ/Bloom#823), which draws that swatch from two 96 x 96 px PNGs (8.5 KB gzip for both) instead of 390 x 390 px: measured 3958552 with Bloom 21.0.0 and 3700187 with 21.1.1 locally (-258365 B gzip). 3710000 is the old 3705000 plus CI's ~5.8 KB higher export, which 3705000 alone would have left 5 KB short of. Raised 3710000 -> 3735000 with Bloom 21.2.0 (OxyHQ/Bloom#824), which stores each avatar part's tracks per clip so an avatar at rest fetches only its idle data (the empty-state gemie: 135 KB brotli instead of 281 KB): measured 3704446 on main and 3727162 after locally (+22716 B gzip). +21864 B of it is the 70 on-demand catalogue wrapper chunks (catalog/<kind>-<id>, 76669 -> 98533 B gzip), which now list each asset's payloads per clip and are loaded one per drawn asset; Bloom's code +650 B. 3735000 is the measurement plus CI's ~5.8 KB higher export. Lowered 3735000 -> 3605000 when the gate moved to @oxy.so/doctor 1.9.0 (`oxy-doctor-web-budget`, OxyHQ/oxy#2279), which counts those wrappers on the avatar catalogue line with the payloads: they are on-demand chunks like the payloads, and a lazy chunk does not belong in the line that guards the code the app loads. The gate runs under Node, as CI does (Node's gzip comes out ~0.7% below Bun's, which the earlier numbers here used): this export measured 3598744 B JS gzip, 29226600 B / 6701579 B gzip of avatar catalogue. 3605000 is that plus ~6 KB; the catalogue lines go from 30500000 / 7080000 to 29400000 / 6750000, ~0.6% over the measurement.
